cues: Start with three molecules of RuBP, a five-carbon sugar: fifteen carbons.
Three carbon dioxide arrive: three more.
The enzyme RuBisCO joins them, and each unstable six-carbon product splits at once into two molecules of 3-PGA.
text: Count carbons. Start with three molecules of RuBP, a five-carbon sugar: fifteen carbons. Three carbon dioxide arrive: three more. The enzyme RuBisCO joins them, and each unstable six-carbon product splits at once into two molecules of 3-PGA. Six 3-PGA: eighteen carbons. Nothing lost.
